1.w: My son, pay attention to my wisdom, [and] to my understanding incline your ear,

2.w: to keep discretion, and [that] your lips may guard knowledge.

3.w: For the lips of the forbidden woman drip honey, and smoother than oil [is] her palate;

4.w: but her end [is] bitter as wormwood, sharp [with] mouths as a sword.

5.w: Her feet go down to death; her steps lay hold of sheol.

6.w: The path of life she does not weigh; her tracks are unstable; she does not know [it].

7.w: And now, sons, listen to me, and do not turn aside from the words of my mouth.

8.w: Keep your path far away from her, and do not go near to the opening of her house,

9.w: lest you give to others your splendor, and your years to a cruel one;

10.w: lest strangers be satisfied [by] your strength, and your labors [be] in the house of a foreigner;

11.w: and you groan at your end, in the consumption of your flesh and your body,

12.w: and you say, “How I hated discipline, and my heart spurned rebuke!

13.w: And I have not listened to the voice of my instructors, and I have not inclined my ear to those teaching me.

14.w: Am I as a little from all evil, in the midst of the assembly and the gathering.”

15.w: Drink water from your own cistern and flowing from the midst of your own well.

16.w: Should your fountains be dispersed outside, channels of water in broad places?

17.w: Let them be for you, yourself alone, and not for strangers with you.

18.w: Let your fountain be blessed, and rejoice with the wife of your youth.

19.w: A loving doe and a graceful deer, let her breasts satisfy you at all times—may you wander in her love continually!

20.w: So why do you wander, my son, with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a foreign woman?

21.w: For the ways of man [are] in front of the eyes of YHWH, and all his paths He weighs.

22.w: His own iniquities capture a wicked one, and he is held with the cords of his sin.

23.w: He shall die for lack of discipline, and in the abundance of his folly he shall go astray.
